summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing a change in the release date of its Fiscal 2026 financial results to May 26, 2026, and a conference call on May 29. This is a routine scheduling update and financial reporting notice. No special situation, merger, acquisition, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven category applies.
